comment: Read at commit 4626190 (JoBoCl/Gemini), the last commit whose plugin.json carries 2.0.1 and whose manifest still has an empty donateUrl, matching the installed one. Eight commits carry 2.0.1; the installed build was narrowed to this end of them two ways: the per-mode tooltip strings added in 82cf668 (Mode - Chorus, Alt mode - enabled, NOOOOOO) are all present in it, and the installed res/Gemini.svg is byte-identical to the panel as rewritten in b47b153. The two commits after b47b153 change only the Makefile's C++ standard and a constexpr initialiser. Panel lettering is symbols throughout - a title band reading Castor & Pollux, an alpha over the Castor half and a beta over the Pollux half, phi over the modulator knob, sigma over the crossfade, and waveform glyphs on the level knobs and duty jacks - so almost no control carries a name and the lines lead with what the control does. The mode knob, the alt button and the filter button have no artwork under them at all. Widget order is not enum order: the four level knobs run left to right as parameters 6, 7, 8 and 12, so the rightmost knob is index 12 and the third is index 8. Three faults found in the code. First, in Hard Sync mode getPolluxPitchCv (line 743) indexes the input array with inputs[POLLUX_PITCH_PARAM], a ParamId whose value 1 lands on POLLUX_DUTY_INPUT, so the Pollux duty jack is read as the sync pitch and the Pollux pitch jack is ignored. Second, in Chorus mode getLfoCv (line 734) passes true for altMode, so the rate comes from the value stored with the alt button on, while getLfoValue (line 726) scales the depth by the value stored with it off - the reverse of the two tooltips, LFO frequency and LFO amplitude level. Third, OscillatorState::pulse (line 178) takes an offset argument and never uses it, so the pulse width centre position that alt mode offers in LFO PWM has no separate effect; the knob still sets the pulse width through getParamRef, it is simply a second stored value rather than a centre. The modulator's rate law is getLfoCv returning 5 * (param + 1) into a base frequency of 2Hz, which is 64Hz to 2048Hz across the knob - quoted in the lines because both constants are in the source. dataToJson (line 381) formats its keys with sprintf into an empty std::string, which has no reserved space; it is left out of the lines because libc++ small-string storage makes the outcome unclear rather than plainly broken. The plugin declares a manualUrl of https://gemini.wntr.dev, which is Winterbloom's documentation for the hardware and not for this port, so nothing was taken from it.
